# Synthesis & Verification — December 2026 Turkey Domestic Legs

**Retrieval date for all schedule claims: 13 October 2026** (my own searches) and 13 Oct 2026 for the upstream subtasks [1.1]–[1.5]. This memo merges legs 1–3, baggage, transfers, risk and fallbacks; resolves conflicts where possible; and separates **verified facts**, **inferences**, and **unverified gaps**.

---

## 0. Verdict summary

| Leg | Date | Route | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Fri Dec 18 | IST/SAW → NAV/ASR | ✅ **WORKABLE** — many daily nonstops; exact clock times unverified |
| 2 | Tue Dec 22 | Cappadocia → İzmir (ADB) | ⚠️ **CONDITIONAL / BORDERLINE** — direct exists ~6 days/wk and Tuesday service is now well-supported, but **exact Dec 22 schedule unverified**; door-to-door ≈5–6 h, i.e. **over the 5 h test** |
| 3 | Thu Dec 24 | ADB → IST (morning) | ✅ **WORKABLE** — multiple daily morning nonstops; ample buffer to the Dec 25 16:30 flight |

---

## 1. Leg 1 — Fri Dec 18, 2026: Istanbul → Cappadocia

**Airlines / days (verified, [1.1]):** IST→NAV Turkish Airlines only (daily); SAW→NAV AJet only; IST→ASR Turkish Airlines only (daily); SAW→ASR Pegasus + AJet. All four are **nonstop and year-round** — no December suspension indicated [1.1]. Turkish Airlines' own Cappadocia page is actively selling IST–NAV for December 2026 [1.1].

**Times:** ⚠️ **Exact Dec 18 clock times are UNVERIFIED** — only the current (summer) timetable was retrievable. Sample IST→NAV pattern: TK2000 06:25→07:45, TK2002 08:15→09:35, TK2004 11:25→12:40, etc. [1.1]. Treat the *existence of daily service* as verified; the *specific times for Dec 18* as unverified.

**Baggage (verified, [1.4]):** Turkish Airlines EcoFly (cheapest) = **15 kg checked + 8 kg cabin**; Pegasus Saver = 15 kg; AJet Basic = **personal item only (0 kg checked)** — and whether AJet's *domestic* Basic is personal-item-only is itself **unverified** [1.4].

**Transfer to Göreme (verified, [1.1]):** NAV→Göreme ~40 km: shared shuttle €10/person (50–60 min), private €60/vehicle (~40 min). ASR→Göreme ~75 km: shared €10/person (75–90 min), private from €70 (~60–75 min). No public bus to Göreme. **Conflict:** NAV taxi ~€18 vs €45–60 [1.1].

**Verdict:** Workable. Prefer a morning IST→NAV (closer to Göreme) or any of the many IST→ASR flights.

---

## 2. Leg 2 — Tue Dec 22, 2026: Cappadocia → İzmir (ADB) — the contested leg

### 2a. The "direct Kayseri–İzmir" conflict — now largely RESOLVED

The route **ASR→ADB is real**, operated by **Pegasus and SunExpress**, **12 weekly departures (6 each)**, flight time 1 h 25 m–1 h 40 m [c1][c2]. My own searches confirm this from multiple independent sources [c1][c2][c11].

**The two original claims are reconcilable:** the direct exists **from Kayseri (ASR)**, not from **Nevşehir (NAV)**. NAV→ADB has **no direct** — SunExpress discontinued it (last flight scheduled 2026-01-31) [1.5]. So "direct ~6 days/week" is true for ASR; "no easy direct route" is true for NAV.

### 2b. Does the direct run on Tuesday Dec 22? — conflict now leans YES

The upstream subtask flagged this as the single most important unresolved item (Google/KAYAK said yes; Tatilsepeti said no) [1.2]. My additional searches **shift the balance toward Tuesday having direct service**:

- **Omio** found **2 direct flights on Tuesday 13 Oct 2026** (ASR→ADB), at 09:20→10:50 and 19:50→21:25 [c3][c4] — direct empirical evidence that Tuesday is served.
- **Trip.com's** reverse-direction (ADB→ASR) weekly grid shows Pegasus PC3190 19:05→20:30 on **all days except Saturday**, and SunExpress XQ9038 06:15→07:45 on **Tue and Thu** [c5][c6] — Tuesday is served in the reverse direction.
- **Directflights** shows 6 flights/week per airline (one day off each) [c2]; **FlightConnections** (older, July 2026) said 10/week [c7].
- **Skyscanner** shows a direct SunExpress ASR→ADB on **Sun 6 Dec 2026** [c8]; **Enuygun** shows direct Pegasus on Wed 4 Nov [c9].

**Conclusion:** the weight of evidence says a direct ASR→ADB flight **very likely operates on Tue Dec 22, 2026**, and the Tatilsepeti "no Tuesday direct" claim is now the outlier. **However, I could not retrieve the actual Week-52 (Dec 21–27) day-by-day timetable, so the exact Dec 22 schedule remains UNVERIFIED** [c30]. Confirm by live booking search before relying on it.

### 2c. Times (pattern, NOT verified for Dec 22)

Early-morning bank ~08:25–08:45 and late-night bank ~19:35–23:35 [1.2]. Sample direct: Pegasus 08:45→10:15; earliest 06:15→07:45 [1.5]. **Exact Dec 22 times unverified** [c28].

### 2d. Balloon feasibility (09:00 landing)

Balloons are sunrise-only; midwinter first lift-off ~07:00–07:30, full experience ~3 h [1.2]. A ~09:00 landing is realistic. **Consequence:** the **morning direct (~08:25/08:45) is NOT compatible** with a 09:00 balloon landing (you'd need to be at ASR ~1.5 h early, and ASR is ~1 h 15 m from Göreme). **Only the evening departure works** for a same-day balloon + flight [1.2].

### 2e. Door-to-door test (inference)

Göreme→ASR (1 h 15 m) + airport buffer (~1.5 h) + flight (1 h 30 m) + ADB→Selçuk (~1 h) ≈ **5 h 15 m** — **marginally over 5 h even on a direct**; via Istanbul clearly over (≈6–7 h+) [1.2][1.5]. **So Leg 2 fails the "under 5 hours" test** [c31, inference].

### 2f. Baggage (verified, [1.2][1.4])

Pegasus domestic cheapest = **Süper Eko 15 kg** (Light not sold domestically); SunExpress domestic cheapest = **SunEco 15 kg** (SunLight is international-only). Both include a checked bag — **no checked-bag surprise** on this leg.

**Verdict:** **Conditional.** Direct exists and Tuesday is likely served, but (i) exact Dec 22 schedule unverified, (ii) door-to-door exceeds 5 h, (iii) only the evening flight is balloon-compatible.

---

## 3. Leg 3 — Thu Dec 24, 2026: İzmir (ADB) → Istanbul (morning)

**Airlines / days (verified, [1.3]):** ADB→IST nonstop by **Turkish Airlines (~93/wk) and Pegasus (~19/wk)**, both daily; ADB→SAW by **Pegasus (~64/wk) and AJet (~45/wk)**, both daily. Year-round trunk route; no December suspension [1.3].

**Morning options (winter pattern; exact Dec 24 times unverified [c29]):**
- ADB→IST: TK2309 05:25→06:45; PC3306 06:40→07:55; TK2311 08:55→10:10 (conflict: NAVITIME says 07:55→09:15); **TK2313 10:40→12:05** (confirmed on winter schedule effective 2026-10-25, daily) [1.3].
- ADB→SAW: PC2213 06:00→07:15; AJet 06:55→08:05; PC2181 07:55→09:10 [1.3].

**Feasibility with the Dec 25 16:30 international departure:** Fully feasible — even the latest morning arrival (12:05) leaves an **overnight buffer of ~28 h**; IST domestic→international MCT is 90 min [1.3]. **Prefer IST** (avoids the SAW→IST cross-city transfer).

**Baggage (verified, [1.3][1.4]):** TK EcoFly 15 kg + 8 kg cabin; Pegasus Saver 15 kg + 8 kg cabin; AJet Basic 15 kg (per [1.3]) — note [1.4] flags AJet Basic as possibly personal-item-only, a **conflict** [c17].

**Verdict:** **Workable.** Book a Turkish Airlines ADB→IST morning flight (e.g. TK2313 10:40→12:05).

---

## 4. Baggage — consolidated (domestic, cheapest fare)

| Airline | Cheapest fare | Cabin (cheapest) | Checked (cheapest) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Turkish Airlines | EcoFly | 8 kg + 4 kg personal | **15 kg** |
| AJet | Basic | 4 kg personal only* | **0 kg** |
| Pegasus | Light | 8 kg | **0 kg** |
| SunExpress | SunLight | 4 kg | **0 kg** |

\* AJet Basic domestic status **unverified** [1.4]. **Practical takeaway:** Turkish Airlines EcoFly is the only cheapest fare bundling a checked bag; the LCCs' lowest tiers exclude it. For "no checked-bag surprises," default to TK EcoFly or buy an LCC bundle.

---

## 5. Ground transfers (consolidated)

- **NAV→Göreme** ~40 km: shared €10/person (50–60 min); private €60 (~40 min) [1.1].
- **ASR→Göreme** ~75 km: shared €10/person (75–90 min); private from €70 (60–75 min) [1.1].
- **ADB→Selçuk** ~70 km: İZBAN train ~1 h 5 m, ~130 TL (change at Tepeköy) [1.2][1.3]; private transfer €50–87 (45–60 min) [1.2][1.3]; taxi $95–120 [1.3]; intercity bus ~€5, ~1 h [1.2]. For a 06:00–07:00 flight, the train is too late (earliest ~07:28) — use a private transfer/taxi [1.3].

---

## 6. December snow / cancellation risk

- **Cappadocia December climate (verified):** highs 4–6 °C, lows −3 to −1 °C, **snowfall on ~5–8 days in December** [1.1][1.5].
- **ASR (Oct 2026 snapshot):** 17% of departures delayed >15 min, avg delay 20 min, **0.00% cancellation** [1.1][1.5]. **NAV:** FlightGuard risk 7/100 ("low") [1.5].
- ⚠️ **No December-specific NAV/ASR cancellation/delay dataset was found — UNVERIFIED** [c26]. All airport stats are live October snapshots. Balloon winter cancel rate ~50% (one operator) vs ~35% (another tracker) — different scopes, not a true contradiction [1.5].
- **ADB (İzmir):** low snow risk (mild Aegean coast) [1.3].

---

## 7. Fallbacks if Leg 2 can't be done in <5 h on Dec 22

1. **Best air alternative to Selçuk/Ephesus:** connect **ASR→IST→ADB** (Turkish Airlines, ~3 h 45 m air, ~1 h 05 m layover) then ADB→Selçuk train [1.2][1.5]. Slower but reliable and same-day.
2. **Best non-air:** overnight intercity bus Göreme/Nevşehir→İzmir (~12 h) — avoids flight-cancellation risk [1.2][1.5].
3. **Ephesus-free fallback for the last days:** **base in İzmir city** (Kemeraltı, Kordon, clock tower — no winter closures, direct ADB access) rather than Çeşme/Alaçatı, which partially shut for winter [1.5]. Alternatively, **skip Selçuk entirely and move to Istanbul a day or two early** (ASR/NAV→IST is a well-served direct route), which also removes the ADB→IST leg-3 risk [1.2, inference].

---

## 8. Conflicts — status after this synthesis

| Conflict | Status |
|---|---|
| Direct ASR→ADB on Tuesday? | **Leans YES** (Omio Tue-13-Oct direct evidence [c3]; Google/KAYAK yes; Trip.com reverse-direction Tue service [c6]); Tatilsepeti "no" is now the outlier. **Exact Dec 22 still unverified** [c30]. |

---

## 9. Verified vs inferred vs unverified

**Verified (tool-backed):** ASR→ADB direct route exists, Pegasus + SunExpress, 12 weekly [c1][c2]; Tuesday direct service observed on 13 Oct [c3][c4]; reverse-direction Tuesday service [c5][c6]; leg-1 and leg-3 route/airline/day structure [1.1][1.3]; baggage tables [1.4]; transfer prices [1.1][1.2][1.3]; Cappadocia December snowfall 5–8 days [1.1][1.5].

**Unverified gaps:** exact Dec 18 / Dec 22 / Dec 24 clock times (winter timetable not retrieved) [c27][c28][c29]; whether the direct ASR→ADB runs on the exact date Tue Dec 22 [c30]; December-specific NAV/ASR cancellation rates [c26]; AJet Basic domestic baggage; TK2311 winter time; NAV taxi price; SAW-connection operator.
